title: Yellowish Indulgent Algerian Boudin Blanc Tagine
description: A mustardy and indulgent Algerian dish featuring boudin-blanc, this tagine is a high-protein friendly meal option, The combination of ingredients creates a rich and savory flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the boudin-blanc into 1-inch thick rounds and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the whole-grain mustard and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the chicken broth, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the sliced boudin-blanc to the Dutch oven and fold the ingredients together gently.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the boudin-blanc is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
